notes.title: Patch 6 is here! Improved Save System arrives!
notes.notes:
The fixes continue! We've listened to your requests, and we've made some important changes, but let's start at the beginning.

The save system - a lot is changing here. We have split the save slots into Story Mode and Sandbox, taking the organization a step further. But that's not the end of the changes, we're introducing the ability to manually save the game!

Also, SANDBOX is now available right away! You no longer have to play through the entire story mode to unlock the additional sandbox mode.

And then the icing on the cake, more new keybinding features. Now you have the ability to keybind mouse buttons (LMB, RMB, middle and mouse buttons 4-7) and to change the key bindings for interactions such as:
 Ask client to leave the pub,
 Hide Beer Tray
 Main objects interaction
Note: Due to the changes in the keybindings system, custom key mappings will reset to default in the newest game version.

Patch Notes
Added saves for story mode and sandbox separately.
Added manual saves.
Changed keybindings now show up correctly in the tutorial.
 Ability to change keybindings for interactions.
Trash will no longer get stuck under the food truck.
Glasses will no longer get stuck under the tap.
Other minor fixes.
And, once again, if any of the fixed issues continue to occur, please try starting a new game. If the errors persist, please report them to us so we can fix them!
Report the bug through this form: https://mov.gs/support/
Include your PC specification: CPU, GPU, RAM
If you encountered a crash, include a crash log from this folder: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator - simply zip up the whole Brewpub Simulator folder and attach the compressed file to your message
Have fun gaming!

notes.title: Patch 5 incoming! See what’s in today
notes.notes:
Brewers, time for patch 5! This one comes with keybinding fixes for your gaming convenience.

Patch Notes
The keybinding responsible for the equipment now works as intended.
When changing keybindings you will no longer see a white box instead of a tip message showing the intended keybinding.
When changing some keybindings they will no longer show as “W” in the UI.
”Reset to default” option added for the keybindings options tab.
The bartender will no longer bug after trying to pick up glasses from the shelf closest to the kitchen entrance.
Other minor fixes.
And, once again, if any of the fixed issues continue to occur, please try starting a new game. If the errors persist, please report them to us so we can fix them!
Report the bug through this form: https://mov.gs/support/
Include your PC specification: CPU, GPU, RAM.
If you encountered a crash, include a crash log from this folder: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator - simply zip up the whole Brewpub Simulator folder and attach the compressed file to your message.

Out of pure curiosity, which keybindings do you most often change and to what?

notes.title: Keybindings patch (beta) just landed!
notes.notes:
Happy International Beer Day, Brewers! Hope you have the time to celebrate the best day of the year 🍺 And of course, we’re celebrating too, with a new patch! 

We have introduced the keybindings you have been waiting for. From now on, you will be able to set key assignments to your liking. We are aware that there are a few bugs along with the keybindings remapping system, but we were very anxious to bring it to you as soon as possible. While you enjoy the new patch, we are brewing fixes of known issues in the keybindings system for the next upcoming patch.

Problems we are aware of
After changing the keybind for inventory, you can still only open the inventory with I
After changing keybindings, some characters do not display correctly in the UI, white squares are displayed instead or incorrect keybind is shown 
Additional macro keys available on keyboards and mouses can’t be used to change keybindings
Besides adding keybindings, we also fixed a few bugs. Full patch notes below.

Patch Notes
The items will no longer fall underground. For sure.
Items will no longer bug after glasses break.
The game will now recognize a big pot being put on a hob in the tutorial.
You can now buy pub extensions without problems.
Other minor fixes.
If any of the fixed issues continue to occur, please try starting a new game. If the errors persist, please report them to us so we can fix them!
Report the bug through this form: https://mov.gs/support/
Include your PC specification: CPU, GPU, RAM
If you encountered a crash, include a crash log from this folder: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator - simply zip up the whole Brewpub Simulator folder and attach the compressed file to your message
Let us know how you celebrate the Beer Day and don’t forget to brew your own in-game!

notes.title: Patch #3 out now! More to come soon
notes.notes:
Hello there!

We realize that some of you are still experiencing issues with the game, but we would like to assure you that we are not slacking off, and another patch is in preparation :) We want to thank you for your feedback on the game. Thanks to you, we are closer to creating the best possible version of Brewpub.

Today, we come with new fixes, including no more randomly smashing glasses! You will find below a list of fixes in this patch. And rest assured, we continue to work on more fixes and other features. Keybindings are on the way!

Patch Notes
Fix for objects falling into furniture and other objects (no more disappearing items).
Fix for player-carried items - they don't get lost along the way.
Fix for a tablet that stopped being interactive in some cases.
Glasses will now follow the player’s movement so they cannot randomly break while being moved from a lower counter to a bar counter.
Glasses can no longer break while being put down.
Pub employees will no longer disappear after loading a save.
The game will no longer freeze after loading a save.
Other minor fixes.

If any of the fixed issues continue to occur, please try starting a new game. If the errors persist, please report them to us so we can fix them!
[olist]
 Report the bug through this form: https://mov.gs/support/
 Include your PC specification: CPU, GPU, RAM
 If you encountered a crash, include a crash log from this folder: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator - simply zip up the whole Brewpub Simulator folder and attach the compressed file to your message
[/olist]

Don’t forget to leave a Steam review (or update your review if you already left one).

Thanks for believing in us and for your support!
Dev Team

notes.title: Fixes are here! New patch is out
notes.notes:
Hello!

We are coming with more fixes! We would like to report that the issue of falling objects should no longer occur. You can be more at ease about your belongings; they should no longer fall into limbo under the bar.

Below is a list of fixes for this patch, and in the meantime, we are returning to work to deliver the next fix as soon as possible. Besides fixes, we are also working on other things to make the game as enjoyable as possible for everyone, such as keybindings.

Patch Notes
Items no longer fall through the floor.
The tablet UI will no longer be non-interactive after opening it.
Liquid from the fermentation bucket will no longer disappear.
Stains generated by the clients will no longer float in the air.
Fixed the issue with items that stopped being interactive in certain circumstances.
Glasses placed in the dishwasher will no longer disappear after loading a save.
Strawberry will no longer appear as chilli peppers in the pop-up about items collected from the delivery box.
Other brewing and recipe-related fixes.
Other minor fixes.

If any fixed issues continue to occur, please try starting a new game. If the errors persist, please report them to us. 

Please continue to report the bugs and problems you encounter in the game. If we know about them, we can fix them. :)

[olist]
 Report the bug through this form: https://mov.gs/support/
 Include your PC specification: CPU, GPU, RAM
 If you encountered a crash, include a crash log from this folder: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator - simply zip up the whole Brewpub Simulator folder and attach the compressed file to your message
[/olist]

We will continue working on fixing other existing problems and making the game better, more patches will be added to the game, and we hope you’ll already have a smoother experience playing!

Don’t forget to leave a Steam review (or update your review if you already left one).

notes.title: The Patch Is Up!
notes.notes:
Hi All!

At the beginning, we would like to thank everyone for playing our game. We see how much you enjoy the gameplay, even with encountered bugs. We will do anything we can to fix as many issues as you have encountered asap. We are launching the first update NOW. You can check the patch notes below :)

We also want to thank all those who reported their errors to us. Each submission with a description, attached save, or recorded video of the error allows us to find and fix the problem faster.

If you’re still experiencing problems, please share them with us so we can fix them.

[olist]
 Report the bug through this form: https://mov.gs/support/
 Include your PC specification: CPU, GPU, RAM
 If you encountered a crash, include a crash log from this folder: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator -  simply zip up the whole Brewpub Simulator folder and attach the compressed file to your message
[/olist]
Patch Notes

Please mind that in order to work, some fixes will require you to start a new game. 

If you choose to start a new game, head to the following directory on your PC: C:\Users\Username\AppData\LocalLow\Star Drifters\Brewpub Simulator, and delete the Brewpub Simulator folder.

Doing this will ensure deletion of issues present in the previous game version. Please keep in mind that deleting AppData deletes all save data.


 Reduced the risk of crashes.
 Improved general optimization.
 Fixed the issue where connecting kegs to the bucket disabled interaction with the latter.
 Fixed the issue with items that stopped being interactive. 
 Patrons don’t break the minigames when you ask them to leave anymore.
 Long game sessions now do not cause the game to slow down.
 Restarting a day does not cause you to lose bonuses anymore.
 Levitating stains now follow the rules of physics.
 Fixed the American Black Ale recipe.
 Brewing Black Ale does not result in a Porter anymore.
 Fixed the dialogue windows not being able to contain all the requirements of more demanding customers.
 Other brewing and recipe-related fixes.
 Other minor fixes.


We hope that this update will improve your experience, Brewers!  And don’t forget to leave a Steam review (or update your review if you already left one).
